title: 1936 Prairie's balconies built as the photograph shows them
items: The balcony over 1936 Prairie's verandah now sits down on its arches as in the old photograph: a pale stone balustrade on a cornice carried by a row of small brackets, where a plain slab in the wall's colour had stood about two feet too high.
The balcony over the entrance porch rises to the photograph's height, its pale stone railing just under the two windows above, so the porch beneath it stands tall on its columns.
